prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, restyle of an existing game location. Image 1 is an in-game screenshot of the Mega Park, a large skate park set into a forested valley of the island in the game Yorimichi, seen from the volcano's lower flank. Image 2 is another place in the same game and shows the art direction to match: soft painterly low-poly shapes, flat matte shading, pale lavender-grey rocks, autumn maples and ginkgos in rust, orange and gold, dark green pines, soft green grass, a clean blue sky. Repaint image 1 as the AFTER concept from exactly the same camera and composition, keeping the low-poly autumn forest around the park as it is. Every skating structure stays exactly as it is, in the same place with the same shape: the concrete bowls, decks, banks, walls, stairs, rails and white buildings. Only the scenery changes: the red and brown desert sandstone cliffs and hoodoos around the park become weathered volcanic rock in the island's lavender-grey, still rugged, layered and blocky like Mount Myogi in Japan, with moss and small autumn maples and pines growing on its ledges and tops so the rim melts into the forest; the thin dead-looking poles and cacti become the island's autumn trees; bare dirt becomes soft green grass with fallen leaves. Keep the park rugged, with a raw skate-spot character, but make it look like it was always part of this island. No people, no UI, no labels.
